repair_rationale.cause_hypothesis: The original change handler ignored its new id argument and seeded through a request captured by the previous view closure. Original evidence showed the new caller context alongside the old seed focus/decisions.
repair_rationale.production_change: Make object/request values Equatable, observe the full request, use the changed request argument to seed decisions/focus, and track the loaded request id so same-id caller edits preserve local decisions.

repair_rationale.cause_hypothesis: PlainButtonStyle adds disabled fading on top of explicit palette roles, matching the original screenshot RGB compositions.
repair_rationale.production_change: Use one custom ButtonStyle returning its configured label, preserving exact explicit palette roles and retaining actual Button .disabled state and accessibility traits.
